summary: Armenia's Foreign Ministry visa search tool says citizens of countries including the US, the UK, Germany, Russia, Japan and the UAE need no visa and can stay up to 180 days in a year, and citizens of China, Iran, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan and Uruguay can stay up to 90 days. Other nationalities, such as Canada and India, can obtain a visa through the e-Visa system, at the border (for India, only with a listed foreign visa or residence permit) or at an embassy; some, such as Tanzania, must obtain one in advance at an embassy by invitation only. From 1 July 2026 to 1 July 2027, nationals of 111 listed countries who hold a residence permit from the US, an EU or Schengen state or a listed Gulf state can enter without a visa.

stayEvidence.text: Citizens of foreign countries for whom a visa-free regime is set can stay on the territory of the Republic of Armenia for no more than 180 days during one year if no other term is defined by the international agreements of the Republic of Armenia.
Citizens of the People's Republic of China with ORDINARY passports can stay in the territory of the Republic of Armenia without visa for a maximum term of 90 days in any 180-day period.
Citizens of Kazakhstan can stay in the territory of the Republic of Armenia without a visa for up to 90 days from the date of crossing the border.
Citizens of Tajikistan can stay in the territory of the Republic of Armenia for 90 days within a 180-day period.
Citizens of Islamic Republic of Iran holding all types of passports can enter, pass through, and stay in Armenia without a visa for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.

Uruguay — Ordinary Passport — Visa is not required Citizens of the selected country with ALL TYPES of passports are NOT REQUIRED to hold a visa when travelling to the Republic of Armenia. Citizens of the selected country can stay in the territory of the Republic of Armenia for a maximum term of 90 days in a year.

defaultStayWindow.text: The MFA states that citizens of countries with a visa-free regime “can stay on the territory of the Republic of Armenia for no more than 180 days during one year if no other term is defined by the international agreements”. It does not say how the year is counted or whether the days of arrival and departure are counted.

source.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Armenia — Visa

conditionalWaivers.text: From 1 July 2026 to 1 July 2027, nationals of 111 listed countries who hold a residence permit issued by the US, an EU or Schengen state, the UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait or Oman, valid for at least six months from entry, can enter without a visa and stay up to 180 days within a one-year period. faq.question: Do I need a visa for Armenia?
faq.answer: Armenia's Foreign Ministry visa search tool says citizens of countries including the US, the UK, Germany, Russia, Japan and the UAE need no visa and can stay up to 180 days in a year; citizens of China, Iran, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan and Uruguay can stay up to 90 days. Other nationalities, such as Canada and India, can obtain a visa through the e-Visa system (a visitor visa for up to 21 or 120 days of stay), at the border (for India, only with a listed foreign visa or residence permit) or at an embassy; some, such as Tanzania, must obtain one in advance at an embassy by invitation only. From 1 July 2026 to 1 July 2027, nationals of 111 listed countries who hold a residence permit from the US, an EU or Schengen state or a Gulf state (the UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait or Oman), valid for at least six months from entry, can enter without a visa for up to 180 days in a year.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Armenia visa-free?
faq.answer: Armenia's Foreign Ministry says citizens of visa-exempt countries such as the US, Germany and Japan can stay up to 180 days in a year. Citizens of China, Iran and Tajikistan can stay 90 days within a 180-day period, citizens of Kazakhstan up to 90 days from the date of crossing the border, and citizens of Uruguay up to 90 days in a year.

faq.question: Can I get an Armenian visa on arrival?
faq.answer: For some nationalities. The Foreign Ministry's visa search tool says some — including Canada — can obtain a visa at the border of Armenia; others, such as India, only if they hold a valid residence permit or visa from the EU or Schengen states, the US, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, the UK, Canada, Russia or Japan, or a residence permit from a Gulf state. For Taiwanese passports it lists only embassies and the e-Visa. The Foreign Ministry recommends applying for an e-Visa at evisa.mfa.am.

faq.question: Is the land border between Armenia and Turkey open?
faq.answer: No. Canada's travel advice says the land border between Türkiye and Armenia is closed, and the UK Foreign Office says the border with Azerbaijan remains closed.
